logic.note: OUT goes HIGH on motion; repeat (H) mode holds it until delay_s after the last motion, single (L) mode gives one delay_s pulse; motion is ignored for 2.5 s after OUT falls (BISS0001 block time).

timing.note: Hold and block times are exact in virtual time; the real Tx knob is not linear and the block time varies (2–3 s) between modules. Warm-up is 0 s by default (prop warmup_s); real modules need 30–60 s.

analog.note: Motion is a yes/no input you set: no detection range (~5–7 m), 110° cone, sensitivity knob, body heat or temperature. The Fresnel lens and pyroelectric element are not modelled.

power.note: 65 µA quiescent from VCC; works from 4.5 V (regulator dropout), not from 3.3 V.

emulates: Hold time and 2.5 s block time
No output when VCC is below 4.5 V
doesNotEmulate: False triggers from heat sources, sunlight, Wi-Fi radios or the warm-up period
Slow movement that a real PIR misses
The non-linear Tx and Sx knobs
testOnRealDevice: Wait 60 s after power-up before testing
Range and angle in your room (sensitivity knob Sx)
False triggers from heaters, sun or a Wi-Fi module next to it
